visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a vertical poster featuring two men, one in a white lab coat and one in a green shirt, set against a background of red roses and a golden frame with the brand 'DR. SHINE' at the top. (2) The scene cuts to an indoor seminar room where Ethan Kuan Kuan, wearing a striped green shirt, stands holding a microphone. He is addressing a seated audience of about fifteen people in a brightly lit, modern room with a chandelier. (3) Ethan is shown in a close-up, smiling while looking at a smartphone; he wears a black smartwatch on his left wrist. (4) A man in a white lab coat, the doctor from the poster, enters a hallway lined with staff and attendees who are clapping and recording with their phones. (5) In the seminar room, a woman in a grey dress reaches into a prize box decorated with floral patterns, held by a staff member in a black mask, while the doctor and Ethan observe from the side. (6) Ethan and the doctor sit on chairs in front of a screen displaying a presentation about aging; they interact with a female audience member, gesturing and laughing. (7) The final phase shows Ethan and a woman laughing together on stage, holding microphones, with a presentation slide in the background.

(4) Laughter from a small crowd erupts following a humorous exchange between Ethan and the doctor on stage. (6) The BGM continues steadily through the final sign-off, ending with a slight fade and Ethan's friendly parting words.
